title: Webb County offices closed for Thanksgiving, Nov. 26–27
excerpt: Webb County announced its administrative offices will be closed for the Thanksgiving holidays on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27.
content:
Webb County administrative offices will be closed for the Thanksgiving holidays on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27.

The county shared the holiday closure notice on Thursday morning, November 19, and wished residents a happy Thanksgiving.

Residents who need county services should plan around the two-day closure.

Source: Webb County, Texas, Facebook, Nov. 19, 2026.
